what: Full audit completed April 14, 2026: 6 parallel agents audited all hooks, recall.ts, store.ts, init.ts, JS helpers, and settings.json registration. Bugs found and fixed: (1) search hook tracked on block allowing bypass — fixed with track-search.sh, (2) path.relative() strips trailing slashes breaking directory query detection — fixed in recall.ts, (3) MCP_TOOLS_LIST missing aide_update and aide_import — fixed in init.ts. Known low-severity: scope with trailing slash (no glob) won't match, --force overwrites non-aide settings. All 1192 tests pass.
why: Comprehensive audit after discovering multiple bugs in hooks and recall. Documents what was checked so future sessions don't re-audit the same things.
